title: Travis Kelce Sends Bold Message to Husbands of Taylor Swift Fans
summary: Travis Kelce reacted to a podcast appearance by Erin Andrews and Charissa Thompson’s husbands, praising them as "The Plus Ones" after they gushed about Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour. His brief comment prompted fan requests for Swift to appear on the Kelce brothers’ podcast and highlighted the sportscasters’ role in the couple's romance. The piece recounts how Andrews and Thompson supported the relationship and celebrated the pair publicly.
content:
Written by Michelle McGahan | April 18, 2025 - 12:36 pm

Travis Kelce has something to say to the husbands of Taylor Swift fans. Especially when it comes to Erin Andrews and Charissa Thompson’s partners, who couldn’t stop raving about Swift’s July 2024 Eras show in London.

Andrews and Thompson recently featured their respective husbands Jarrett Stoll and Steve Cundari on their Calm Down podcast, during which Stoll and Cundari expressed their awe and respect for Swift’s performance, stamina, and all-around “wild” production. They also spoke about spending time with Travis’ brother, Jason Kelce, and his wife, Kylie Kelce, at the show.

It was when the sportscasters — who have played a pivotal role in Swift and Travis’ romance — promoted the podcast episode on social media that the Kansas City Chiefs tight end sent a message to Stoll and Cundari.

The Plus Ones are here! Andrews and Thompson captioned a clip from the episode, noting “@stolly28 & @stevencundari join the show for lots of laughs & setting the record straight!”

Travis, for his part, commented: “Shoutout to The Plus Ones!!! 👏🏻👏🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻.”

While it was unclear if the NFL star was referring directly to Stoll and Cundari, his message can also be interpreted as a nod to himself (and his role as a “plus one” to Swift), or even to all Swifties’ “plus ones” at her concerts. His comment also prompted fans to request that Swift join the Kelce brothers’ own podcast, New Heights, as his own plus one. Kylie, who has her own wildly successful podcast, has appeared on New Heights multiple times, and while the Kelces occasionally mention Travis’ relationship with Swift, the singer herself has never made an appearance on the pod.

As for how Andrews and Thompson helped shape the “Shake It Off” singer’s romance with Travis, Andrews — who has since become friends with the couple — sent a public message to Swift after Travis revealed in July 2023 that he attempted to give the 14-time Grammy winner his phone number after her Eras Tour show at Arrowhead Stadium.

“Taylor, do this for America. Date him,” Andrews recalled saying on the podcast in a later interview on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon.

“We’ll take the credit,” Thompson added. “I just love both of them, and I’m so happy to see them happy.”

The exchange highlights the intersection of sports, celebrity culture, and podcast media in shaping public narratives around high-profile relationships. Fans remain eager for crossover moments, especially a potential Swift appearance on the Kelces’ platform, even as friends and media personalities continue to celebrate the couple.
